description: This file defines a PHP class `BedrockDataAutomationRuntimeClient` used as a client to interact with the Amazon Bedrock Data Automation runtime service. It includes method annotations for synchronous and asynchronous operations related to data automation status and invocation.

classes.name: BedrockDataAutomationRuntimeClient
classes.description: A client class extending AwsClient, used for interfacing with Amazon Bedrock Data Automation runtime service.

methods.name: getDataAutomationStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status of the data automation process, synchronously.

methods.name: getDataAutomationStatusAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the status of the data automation process.

methods.name: invokeDataAutomationAsyncAsync
methods.description: An additional asynchronous invocation method, possibly a variation or typo included in annotations.
